While this space exists, Bloomwater Blades will constantly rain down and attack opponents within its AoE, dealing Hydro DMG and increasing the Normal Attack DMG of characters within. Bloomwater Blades will be created throughout the ability's entire duration. Each Bloomwater Blade targets a random opponent in the area that has not been targeted by the last or Bloomwater Blades. If all opponents in the area have been targeted by the last or Bloomwater Blades, or if there are no opponents in the area, then the next Bloomwater Blade strikes somewhere random in the area.
